author: Marlon Chaviano
name: docs-starlight
title: Docs with Starlight
description: A documentation site with Starlight (Astro): navigation, search, dark mode, i18n and Markdown/MDX pages from minute one.
instructions:
## How to work here

- Each page is a `.md`/`.mdx` file in `src/content/docs/`; the file path is the URL. The sidebar is defined in `astro.config.mjs` (`sidebar`).
- Use Starlight components (`Tabs`, `Card`, `Aside`, `Steps`) in MDX instead of custom HTML.
- Write for readers in a hurry: a clear title, one paragraph of context, then the steps.
- Before finishing: `npm run build` (it also checks internal links).
